title: Return Frequency Multiplier on Restocking Fees
content:
Returns & Exchanges restocking fees on grade B units are multiplied for customers who return often. Return frequency is read from the customer's Marlowe Rewards points ledger: the number of points reversals posted in the last 12 calendar months.

## Multiplier

| Points reversals posted in the last 12 calendar months | Multiplier on the restocking fee per unit |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 2 |
| 3 to 5 | 1.5 |
| 0 to 2 | None (the fee per unit as worked out) |

- The multiplier acts on the restocking fee per unit as already rounded to the cent; the multiplied fee per unit is rounded half up to the cent, and the per-unit cap applies only after this multiplication.
- Only points reversals are counted; earnings, bonuses and other postings are not.

## Boundaries

| Reversals | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 2 | None |
| 3 | 1.5 |
| 5 | 1.5 |
| 6 | 2 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Fee per unit 13.50, 4 reversals: 13.50 times 1.5 is 20.25.
- Fee per unit 13.50, 7 reversals: 27.00.
- Fee per unit 18.00, 6 reversals: 36.00, which the per-unit cap of 30.00 then brings down to 30.00.
